question: What effect does the expansion of the power of knowledge have on entities abiding in that knowledge?
premises: The power of knowledge undergoes expansion.
Some entities abide in the state of that knowledge.
Those entities possess an unfolding radiance of their own.
inference: When the power of knowledge expands, entities abiding in that knowledge attain fullness with their own radiance unfolding.
plain_english: This is the expansion of the power of knowledge: entities abiding in the state of that knowledge attain fullness, with their own radiance unfolding.
